already_adjudicated.subject: chemistry
already_adjudicated.question_en: The sum of three values 12.0, 19.034 and 2.0143 is equal to X. The number of significant figures in X is
already_adjudicated.note: ADJUDICATED by hand 2026-09-07: the green tick is on the FOURTH option, whose text is "3". 12.0+19.034+2.0143 = 33.0483, and addition is limited by the fewest decimal places (12.0 has one), so X = 33.0 = three significant figures. The official key (4) is correct; this agent's reading of 3 was a misread. marked_correct is left as the agent read it so the disagreement rate stays honest.
